title: ❌ Santa Has Left the Building
content: It's the Christmas season, which means Santas are popping up everywhere, but not all of them are bringing the magic. In a post by Wordshore, fellow MeFite thecincinnatikid recalls the moment he discovered the truth about Santa (spoiler: he's not real), thanks to a holiday experience that went sideways. It's not exactly a fantastic holiday memory, but it is memorable.
author: Brandon Blatcher
